inclusion_rule: Speech or silent-speech decoding studies whose ledger names a skin-mounted mechanical sensor (strain sensor or gauge, piezoresistive, piezoelectric or triboelectric film, textile or crack-based sensor, artificial throat); the design compared is the number of sensing channels (one versus several) and the placement (throat or neck versus face). Boundary: contactless radar and palatal pressure plates are excluded when read; reviews counted but not used as state of the art.
